text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Kobe Shimbun Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen considers all the training she's done up to this point and imagines how the race will develop.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She declares that she'll secure victory, then heads for the track.
